results.name: Sci-fi Style Ceiling Light
results.description:
Low-poly futuristic sci-fi style ceiling lamp with two tube bulbs.

Using a PAID!!! TurboSquid model as a visual reference. This was created from scratch, not using any of the assets from the linked example.

2K PBR Textures included.

ORM texture is Ambient (O)cclusion, (R)oughness, (M)etallic, and is a packed map where RGB channels refer to the Occlusion, Roughness, and Metallic.

Normal map is a bit poo, my bad, it's fine but could be improved with more skill.

2 meshes included - "high" contains the ID maps to make it easy to bake your own textures.

Free to use and modify. Created to prove that it's really not necessary to charge money for such a simple mesh.
